Why National College ?

  • 105 year old institution with a built-up area of nearly 2 Lakh sq. ft.
  • Qualified and Experienced Staff
  • State-of-art laboratory facilities in all science department
  • Instrumentation Facility with SEM, HPLC, GC-MS, AAS, Flow Cytometer, Micro Hardness Tester, Fluorescence Spectrophotometer
  • wi-fi enabled with extensive high-speed internet access
  • Indoor stadium with basket ball and badminton courts.
  • 400m athletic track, cricket and soccer pitch
  • Stationery shop and Photocopier Centre
  • Modernized library with more than 1 Lakh volumes
  • Modern student accommodation (separate for boys and girls) with the option of day, weekly or full boarding
  • Multi-purpose hall and amphitheatre
